content.short: pier wallet is a smart contract wallet with social and authenticator recovery.
content.description: pier wallet is a smart contract wallet with social and authenticator recovery, and support for account abstraction and flexible gas management. It serves both individuals and businesses, including a wallet-as-a-service option for commercial clients. Key features include seed-phrase-less onboarding, gas-fee automation and gas-free transactions on Polygon. The platform also offers NFT-community capabilities with push notifications to token holders, addressing communities and creators.
